UnitStatement: Test module covers DEL-17-07 conservative PCF export packages.

FORBIDDEN_PAYLOAD_TEXT enumerates strings that must never appear in a PCF export package: real client, asme table, b31j, certified-by-OpenPipeStress, code-compliant, professional-acceptance, compatible-with-caepipe.
build_from_source builds a PCF export package from the invented source payload fixture.
Test asserts the schema, package fixture, and builder output all validate against pcf_export.schema.json.
PCF export builder is deterministic: two builds yield identical canonical JSON.
PCF export package deliverable_id is DEL-17-07 and package_status is conservative_pcf_export_foundation.
PCF export_profile target_family is pcf, target_profile_version_basis is TBD, and identity_policy is authoritative_sidecar_id_map.
PCF package members are exactly: manifest, model_pcf, unit_system_disclosure, stable_id_map, loss_report, validation_report, diagnostics.
PCF unit_system_disclosure references unit-system:dec-018-si-dual-display with target export coordinate units MM and conversion_performed True.
PCF unit_system_disclosure marks protected_content_included False.
All PCF manifest checksums match the sha256: 64-hex pattern; no diagnostic has severity blocking.
PCF text is byte-stable ASCII, equals the rendered fixture, ends with END-ISOGEN, and includes the invented pipeline reference, component identifier, outside-diameter, and wall-thickness.
PCF text omits internal element id element:invented:AB; stable id metadata is carried only by sidecar_id_map.
Loss report covers required categories exactly: exported, omitted, approximated, delegated, unsupported, tbd.
Loss report includes reasons for unresolved target profile/version and hidden downstream translator defaults.
PCF export_profile support_restraint_policy is unsupported_or_tbd_until_source_confirmed and translator_default_policy is hidden_defaults_blocked_or_loss_reported.

Negative case: missing stable_id_map, missing explicit wall_thickness, and overclaimed target profile produce diagnostics PCF-STABLE-ID-MAP-MISSING, PCF-EXPLICIT-FIELD-MISSING, PCF-TARGET-PROFILE-OVERCLAIM and validation_status blocked.
Profile source_basis_refs are required: their absence yields PCF-SOURCE-BASIS-REFS-MISSING and validation_status blocked.

PCF package contains no prohibited professional or external-compatibility language; professional_boundary disclaims release, target-compatibility, solver-validation, code-compliance, and professional-reliance claims.
